wrong_key_scope.rationale: The starter has no idempotency keys at all, so it is trivially merchant-independent; the natural first implementation uses the client-supplied key as the unique key, and scoping it by merchant is the extra step a hurried solver skips.

wrong_round_daily.rationale: The float starter never rounds before posting, so it passes test_small_balance_daily_accrues; the Decimal rewrite that the ticket requires invites quantizing each day's accrual to cents to keep every money value at two decimals, which makes small balances accrue nothing.

wrong_inclusive_2359.rationale: The UTC starter already ends the period at the exclusive start of the next month, so test_microsecond_boundary passes on it; moving the period to local time invites rewriting the end as the last second of the local month (23:59:59), the way monthly statements are usually described in prose, which drops the final fractional second.
